recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a broader rename, relocation, or narrative example for DefinedParameters; the necessary current-core correction was the missing active pack-list connection.
issue_request: FHIR-32963 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core request to define a way to communicate ParameterDefinition metadata for Parameters.parameter entries with no value, and to define a DefinedParameters profile that allows that extension for expression evaluation operations.
initial_application: Commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038 from PR HL7/fhir#2358 added the DefinedParameters profile and a Parameters-cqf implementation guide, but the new Parameters-cqf reference in source/parameters/list-Parameters-packs.xml was left XML-commented. Later commits retained the profile and FHIR-32965 extended it with dataAbsentReason support.
additional_context: The Jira resolution called the extension cqf-parameterDefinition, but the applied R5 source used the generic parameters-definition extension on Parameters.parameter. The older cqf-parameterDefinition extension is a separate FHIR-15751 TriggerDefinition/ParameterDefinition extension now in the FHIR Extension Pack. Current R5 and CI Parameters profile pages did not surface DefinedParameters while the pack reference remained inactive.
reconciliation: Changed source/parameters/list-Parameters-packs.xml to make the existing ImplementationGuide/Parameters-cqf List.entry active. No new profile or extension was added; the existing guide already references StructureDefinition/definedparameters, and the profile already allows Parameters.parameter.extension:definition using the parameters-definition extension.
source_changes: source/parameters/list-Parameters-packs.xml: uncommented the existing Parameters-cqf List.entry so the DefinedParameters profile is surfaced with the active Parameters profile packs.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue adding dataAbsentReason support to the DefinedParameters profile; already audited on the combined branch and not republished here.
